.slide{--fit:1;--fh:min(1,var(--fit));position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:96px 120px;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:calc(36px*var(--fit));line-height:1.42;
  visibility:hidden;font-kerning:normal;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.slide.is-current,.slide.is-active,.kp-frame .slide{visibility:visible}
.slide.is-active{z-index:1}.slide.is-top{z-index:2}
.notes{display:none}
/* hero tone: title, section, closing, full-bleed (or data-tone="hero"); data-tone="plain" opts out */
.slide:is([data-layout="title"],[data-layout="section"],[data-layout="closing"],[data-layout="full-bleed"],[data-tone="hero"]):not([data-tone="plain"]){
  --bg:var(--hero-bg);--ink:var(--hero-ink);--ink2:var(--hero-ink2);--rule:var(--hero-rule);--rule-strong:var(--hero-ink);--brand:var(--hero-brand);--brand-text:var(--hero-brand)}

/* ---------- 2. Type ---------- */
.slide :is(h1,h2,h3,p,ul,ol,figure,blockquote,pre,dl,dd){margin:0}
.slide h1,.slide h2{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);letter-spacing:var(--ls-display);line-height:1.04;text-wrap:balance}
.slide h1{font-size:calc(var(--t-display)*var(--fh))}
.slide h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-h2)*var(--fh));margin-block-end:56px;max-width:1500px}
.slide h3{font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--t-h3)*var(--fh));line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.slide p{text-wrap:pretty}
.slide em{font-style:var(--em-style);color:var(--brand-text)}
.slide :is(h1,h2) em{background:var(--em-fill,linear-gradient(var(--brand-text),var(--brand-text)));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent;padding-inline-end:.1em;margin-inline-end:-.06em}
.slide :is(h1,h2) em{font-style:var(--em-style)}
.slide strong{font-weight:650}
.slide a{color:var(--brand-text)}
.label{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:var(--t-small);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ink2);margin-block-end:28px}
.lede{font-size:calc(44px*var(--fit));line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink2);max-width:1200px}
.src{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:var(--t-small);color:var(--ink2)}
.slide small{font-size:.8em;color:var(--ink2)}

/* ---------- 3. Layouts ---------- */
/* title */
[data-layout="title"]{justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:210px}
[data-layout="title"] .label{position:absolute;top:100px;inset-inline-start:120px;margin:0;white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="title"] h1{max-width:1560px;margin-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="title"] .sub{font-size:calc(48px*var(--fit));line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink2);max-width:1240px}
.meta{position:absolute;bottom:96px;inset-inline:120px;display:flex;gap:56px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule);padding-top:24px;
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:var(--t-small);color:var(--ink2)}
.meta :last-child{margin-inline-start:auto}
/* section */
[data-layout="section"]{justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:150px}
[data-layout="section"] .label{position:absolute;top:100px;inset-inline-start:120px;margin:0;white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="section"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-display)*.95*var(--fit));max-width:1400px;margin-block-end:32px}
[data-layout="section"] p:not(.label):not(.src){font-size:calc(44px*var(--fit));color:var(--ink2);max-width:1000px}
.num{position:absolute;top:96px;inset-inline-end:120px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:520px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.06em;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--brand-text);pointer-events:none}
/* statement */
[data-layout="statement"]{justify-content:center}
[data-layout="statement"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-h1)*var(--fit));line-height:1.02;max-width:1620px;margin:0}
[data-layout="statement"] p{margin-block-start:56px;font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));color:var(--ink2);max-width:1000px}
[data-layout="statement"] .label{margin-block-end:48px}
/* agenda */
[data-layout="agenda"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;align-content:start}
[data-layout="agenda"] h2{grid-column:1/6;grid-row:1;align-self:start}
[data-layout="agenda"] .label{grid-column:1/6;grid-row:1;margin:0 0 20px}
[data-layout="agenda"]{grid-template-rows:1fr}
[data-layout="agenda"] ol{grid-column:6/13;grid-row:1;counter-reset:ag;list-style:none;padding:0;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);align-self:center}
[data-layout="agenda"] li{counter-increment:ag;display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr auto;align-items:baseline;gap:0 24px;padding:calc(34px*var(--fit)) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:calc(56px*var(--fit));line-height:1.15;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);letter-spacing:var(--ls-display)}
[data-layout="agenda"] li::before{content:counter(ag);font:500 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text);letter-spacing:0}
[data-layout="agenda"] li small{font:400 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2);letter-spacing:0}
[data-layout="agenda"] ol:has([aria-current]) li:not([aria-current]){color:var(--ink2);font-weight:400}
/* bullets (auto-sized by --fit and the item count) */
[data-layout="bullets"] ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(34px*var(--fit));max-width:1360px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin-block:auto;padding-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="bullets"] li{position:relative;padding-inline-start:60px;font-size:calc(var(--bs,52px)*var(--fit));line-height:1.22;text-wrap:balance}
[data-layout="bullets"] li::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:4px;top:.5em;width:20px;height:20px;background:var(--brand);border-radius:var(--radius,0);transform:translateY(-50%) scale(.8)}
[data-layout="bullets"] li small{display:block;font-size:.58em;line-height:1.35;margin-top:8px}
[data-layout="bullets"][data-n="3"]{--bs:60px}[data-layout="bullets"][data-n="4"]{--bs:54px}[data-layout="bullets"][data-n="5"]{--bs:48px}[data-layout="bullets"][data-n="6"]{--bs:42px}
/* two-column */
[data-layout="two-column"] .cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;margin-block:auto;padding-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col{grid-column:span 6;padding-inline-end:56px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:32px}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col+.col{padding-inline-end:0}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col h3{margin-block-end:24px;font-size:calc(56px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col p{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col ul{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col li{padding-inline-start:36px;position:relative;line-height:1.35}
[data-layout="two-column"] .col li::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:0;top:.62em;width:16px;height:2px;background:var(--brand)}
/* image-left / image-right */
[data-layout^="image-"]{justify-content:center}
[data-layout="image-left"]{padding-inline-start:960px}
[data-layout="image-right"]{padding-inline-end:960px}
[data-layout^="image-"] h2{margin-block-end:40px}
[data-layout^="image-"] p:not(.label):not(.src){font-size:calc(36px*var(--fit));color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.5}
[data-layout^="image-"] p+p{margin-block-start:24px}
[data-layout^="image-"] ul{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;font-size:calc(36px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout^="image-"] li{padding-inline-start:40px;position:relative;line-height:1.35}
[data-layout^="image-"] li::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:0;top:.62em;width:18px;height:2px;background:var(--brand)}
figure.fig{position:absolute;inset-block:0;width:840px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg2)}
[data-layout="image-left"]>figure.fig{inset-inline-start:0}
[data-layout="image-right"]>figure.fig{inset-inline-end:0}
figure.fig>img,.bleed{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
/* placeholder art when a figure has no image: concentric linework and one brand quarter */
figure.fig:not(:has(img))::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%,transparent 0 58px,var(--rule) 58px 60px)}
figure.fig:not(:has(img))::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-end:0;bottom:0;width:380px;height:380px;background:var(--brand);border-start-start-radius:100%}
/* full-bleed */
[data-layout="full-bleed"]{padding:0;justify-content:flex-end;color:var(--hero-ink)}
[data-layout="full-bleed"]:not(:has(.bleed)){background:var(--bleed-bg);--bg:var(--bleed-bg);--ink:var(--bleed-ink);--ink2:var(--bleed-ink);--brand-text:var(--bleed-ink);color:var(--bleed-ink)}
[data-layout="full-bleed"]:not(:has(.bleed))::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0,transparent 0 78px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bleed-ink) 22%,transparent) 78px 80px)}
[data-layout="full-bleed"] .bleed{position:absolute;inset:0}
[data-layout="full-bleed"]:has(.bleed)::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--scrim)}
[data-layout="full-bleed"]:has(.bleed){--ink:var(--on-image);--ink2:var(--on-image);color:var(--on-image)}
[data-layout="full-bleed"]>:not(.bleed){position:relative;z-index:1;margin-inline:120px}
[data-layout="full-bleed"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-h1)*var(--fh));margin-block-end:120px;max-width:1400px}
[data-layout="full-bleed"] h2:has(+ p:not(.label)){margin-block-end:28px}
[data-layout="full-bleed"] h2 em{background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor;color:inherit}
[data-layout="full-bleed"] p:not(.label):not(.src){font-size:44px;max-width:1100px;margin-block-end:110px}
[data-layout="full-bleed"] .label{color:inherit;position:absolute;top:96px;margin:0;margin-inline-start:120px}
/* big-number */
[data-layout="big-number"]{justify-content:center}
[data-layout="big-number"] .big{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(400px*var(--fit));line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.05em;color:var(--brand-text);white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:.04em}
[data-layout="big-number"] .big small{font-size:.36em;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink);margin-inline-start:.08em}
[data-layout="big-number"] p:not(.label):not(.src){margin-block-start:48px;padding-top:32px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);font-size:calc(46px*var(--fit));line-height:1.28;max-width:1200px;text-wrap:balance}
[data-layout="big-number"] .src{margin-block-start:20px}
/* stats */
[data-layout="stats"] .stat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;margin-block:auto;padding-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat{align-self:start;border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:32px;min-width:0}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);letter-spacing:-0.04em;line-height:1;font-size:calc(var(--sn,150px)*var(--fit));color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat b small{font-size:.5em;color:var(--brand-text);margin-inline-start:.06em;letter-spacing:0}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat span{display:block;margin-top:24px;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink2);max-width:460px}
[data-layout="stats"][data-n="2"] .stat{grid-column:span 6}[data-layout="stats"][data-n="2"]{--sn:230px}
[data-layout="stats"][data-n="3"] .stat{grid-column:span 4}[data-layout="stats"][data-n="3"]{--sn:200px}
[data-layout="stats"][data-n="4"] .stat{grid-column:span 3}[data-layout="stats"][data-n="4"]{--sn:150px}
/* chart: text left (cols 1-4), plot right (cols 5-12); add data-wide for a full-width plot */
[data-layout="chart"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;align-content:stretch}
[data-layout="chart"]>.label{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1}
[data-layout="chart"]>h2{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2;margin-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="chart"]>.kp-side{grid-column:1/5;grid-row:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;padding-block-end:8px}
[data-layout="chart"]>.kp-side>.src{margin-block-start:auto}
[data-layout="chart"]>.kp-side>.lede{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="chart"]>figure{grid-column:5/-1;grid-row:3;min-height:0}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>.kp-side{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:3;padding:0}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]{grid-template-rows:auto auto auto 1fr}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>.kp-side:empty{display:none}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>figure{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:4}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>.kp-side>.lede{font-size:calc(var(--t-h3)*var(--fit));margin-block-end:8px}
/* comparison */
[data-layout="comparison"] h2{margin-block-end:44px}
table.cmp{margin-block:auto}
/* timeline */
[data-layout="timeline"] h2{margin-block-end:0}
.slide .timeline{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;margin-block:auto;position:relative}
.timeline li{flex:1;min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 56px auto 1fr;padding-inline-end:40px;position:relative}
.timeline li::before{content:"";grid-row:2;align-self:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand);position:relative;z-index:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--bg)}
.timeline li::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:calc(1.4em + 28px);inset-inline:0;height:2px;background:var(--rule-strong);margin-top:-1px}
.timeline li:last-child::after{inset-inline-end:auto;width:24px}
.timeline time{grid-row:1;font:500 var(--t-small)/1.4 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
.timeline h3{grid-row:3;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:calc(46px*var(--fit))}
.timeline p{font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink2)}
.timeline li.now::before{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--bg),0 0 0 11px var(--brand)}
/* process */
.slide .steps{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;gap:76px;margin-block:auto;counter-reset:st}
.steps li{flex:1;min-width:0;position:relative;counter-increment:st;border:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:44px 40px 52px;background:var(--bg)}
.steps li::before{content:counter(st);display:block;font:500 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text);margin-block-end:96px}
.steps li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;inset-inline-start:calc(100% + 8px);width:60px;height:2px;background:var(--rule-strong);transform-origin:left center}
.steps li:not(:last-child)::before{}
.steps h3{margin-block-end:14px;font-size:calc(48px*var(--fit))}
.steps p{font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink2)}
[dir="rtl"] .steps li:not(:last-child)::after{transform:scaleX(-1)}
/* quote */
[data-layout="quote"]{justify-content:center;padding-inline:200px}
[data-layout="quote"] blockquote{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(96px*var(--fit));line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:var(--ls-display);text-wrap:balance;position:relative}
[data-layout="quote"] blockquote::before{content:"\201C";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-0.62em;top:-.02em;color:var(--brand-text);font-size:1.3em;line-height:1}
[dir="rtl"] [data-layout="quote"] blockquote::before{content:"\201D"}
[data-layout="quote"] cite{display:block;margin-block-start:56px;padding-top:28px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);max-width:620px;font:normal 500 30px/1.4 var(--f-body);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="quote"] cite b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
/* code */
[data-layout="code"] h2{margin-block-end:36px}
[data-layout="code"] .label{margin-block-end:20px}
/* team */
.slide .people{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--cols,4),1fr);gap:56px 40px;margin-block:auto}
[data-layout="team"] .person{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
[data-layout="team"] .person img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:var(--bg2)}
[data-layout="team"] .person:not(:has(img))::before{content:attr(data-initials);display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;width:100%;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--brand-text);font:var(--w-display) 110px/1 var(--f-display);letter-spacing:var(--ls-display);border-bottom:6px solid var(--brand)}
[data-layout="team"] .person b{display:block;font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));font-weight:650;line-height:1.2}
[data-layout="team"] .person span{display:block;font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));color:var(--ink2);margin-top:6px}
/* references: numbered sources; cite them in slides with <sup class="cite">[1]</sup> */
[data-layout="references"] .refs{list-style:none;padding:0;counter-reset:ref;margin-block:auto;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);padding-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="references"] .refs li{counter-increment:ref;display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;column-gap:24px;padding:calc(22px*var(--fit)) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.35}
[data-layout="references"] .refs li::before{content:"[" counter(ref) "]";font:500 var(--t-small)/1.6 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="references"] .refs cite{font-style:normal;font-weight:600}
[data-layout="references"] .refs span{color:var(--ink2)}
.slide sup.cite{font:500 .5em/1 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text);vertical-align:.7em;margin-inline-start:.15em}
/* closing */
[data-layout="closing"]{justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:140px}
[data-layout="closing"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-display)*1.4*var(--fit));letter-spacing:-0.045em;line-height:.95;margin-block-end:56px}
[data-layout="closing"] .contact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 72px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule);padding-top:32px;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="closing"] .contact b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
[data-layout="closing"] .label{position:absolute;top:100px;inset-inline-start:120px;margin:0;white-space:nowrap}


/* diagram: h2 + one SVG figure (author the SVG at viewBox 1680 wide so 1 unit = 1px) */
[data-layout="diagram"] h2{margin-block-end:28px}
[data-layout="diagram"] figure.dg{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
[data-layout="diagram"] figure.dg svg{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible;font-family:var(--f-body)}
[data-layout="diagram"] figcaption{font:var(--t-small)/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2);margin-top:16px}
.dg-box{fill:none;stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:3}.dg-fill{fill:var(--bg2);stroke:none}.dg-hot{fill:none;stroke:var(--hot);stroke-width:5}
.dg-line{fill:none;stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.dg-line.hot{stroke:var(--hot);stroke-width:5}
.dg-t{fill:var(--ink);font-size:36px;font-weight:600}.dg-s{fill:var(--ink2);font-size:28px}.dg-m{fill:var(--ink2);font:500 28px var(--f-mono)}.dg-b{fill:var(--brand-text);font-size:36px;font-weight:650}
.dg-dot{fill:var(--ink)}.dg-dot.hot{fill:var(--hot)}
/* ---- library layouts: case, ask, rows, quiz, materials, formula; two-column data-cols="3" ---- */
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] .col{grid-column:span 4;padding-inline-end:40px}
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] .col:last-of-type{padding-inline-end:0}
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] .col h3{font-size:calc(48px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] :is(.col p,.col ul){font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)))}
/* case: summary left, vitals + course right (clinical case, incident, customer story) */
[data-layout="case"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr auto auto 1fr;align-content:stretch}
[data-layout="case"]>:is(h2,.label){grid-column:1/-1}
[data-layout="case"]>.label{grid-row:1}[data-layout="case"]>h2{grid-row:2}
[data-layout="case"] .pt{grid-column:1/6;grid-row:4/6;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:28px;padding-inline-end:24px}
[data-layout="case"] .pt h3{font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);margin-block-end:10px}
[data-layout="case"] .pt p{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));line-height:1.36;margin-block-end:30px}
[data-layout="case"] .pt p:last-child{margin-block-end:0}
[data-layout="case"] .vitals{grid-column:6/-1;grid-row:4;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:0 28px;margin-block-end:48px}
[data-layout="case"] .vital{border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:20px;min-width:0}
[data-layout="case"] .vital span{display:block;font:500 max(28px,calc(26px*var(--fit)))/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="case"] .vital b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(84px*var(--fit));line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-0.03em;white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="case"] .vital small{font-size:max(28px,calc(28px*var(--fit)));letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink2);margin-inline-start:.2em}
[data-layout="case"] .vital[data-flag] b{color:var(--hot-text,var(--brand-text))}
[data-layout="case"] .vital[data-flag]::after{content:attr(data-flag);display:block;margin-top:6px;font:500 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--hot-text,var(--brand-text))}
[data-layout="case"] .course{grid-column:6/-1;grid-row:5;list-style:none;padding:0;margin-inline-start:7px;border-inline-start:2px solid var(--rule-strong);align-self:start}
[data-layout="case"] .course li{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;gap:0 20px;padding:calc(16px*var(--fit)) 0 calc(16px*var(--fit)) 36px;font-size:calc(36px*var(--fit));line-height:1.3}
[data-layout="case"] .course li::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-9px;top:calc(16px*var(--fit) + .4em);width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand)}
[data-layout="case"] .course time{font:500 max(28px,calc(26px*var(--fit)))/1.5 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
/* ask: the raise (amount, use of funds, terms); also budget asks and grant requests */
[data-layout="ask"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr auto;align-content:start}
[data-layout="ask"]>:is(h2,.label){grid-column:1/-1}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount{grid-column:1/7;grid-row:3;align-self:center}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(300px*var(--fit));line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.05em;color:var(--brand-text);white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount b small{font-size:.5em;letter-spacing:-0.02em;margin-inline-start:.04em}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount span{display:block;margin-top:20px;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink2);max-width:700px}
[data-layout="ask"] .use{grid-column:8/-1;grid-row:3;align-self:center;list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(34px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="ask"] .use li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px 20px;align-items:baseline;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));line-height:1.2}
[data-layout="ask"] .use li span{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:500;font-size:.8em}
[data-layout="ask"] .use li i{grid-column:1/-1;display:block;height:18px;width:calc(var(--w,50)*1%);background:var(--brand);border-radius:var(--radius)}
[data-layout="ask"] .terms{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:4;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:40px;border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:24px;margin-block-start:48px}
[data-layout="ask"] .terms dt{font:500 max(28px,calc(24px*var(--fit)))/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="ask"] .terms dd{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
/* rows: labelled rows (issue / rule / application / conclusion; situation / complication / resolution; claim / evidence) */
[data-layout="rows"] h2{margin-block-end:36px}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr;column-gap:40px;padding:calc(24px*var(--fit)) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li::before{content:attr(data-k);grid-row:1/span 2;font:500 max(28px,calc(28px*var(--fit)))/1.5 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li>*{grid-column:2}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows h3{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));margin-block-end:6px}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows p{font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.38;color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li[data-hot]{background:var(--bg2);box-shadow:-28px 0 0 var(--bg2),28px 0 0 var(--bg2);border-bottom-color:var(--brand)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li[data-hot] p{color:var(--ink)}
/* quiz: a question and 2 to 4 options; data-build="reveal" on the list marks the right answer on click */
[data-layout="quiz"]{justify-content:center}
[data-layout="quiz"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-h2)*var(--fit));margin-block-end:64px;max-width:1560px}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px 40px;counter-reset:q}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li{counter-increment:q;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;border:max(var(--rule-w,1px),2px) solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:calc(40px*var(--fit)) 40px;font-size:calc(50px*var(--fit));line-height:1.22;transition:background-color .4s,color .4s,border-color .4s}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li::before{content:counter(q,upper-alpha);flex:none;width:84px;height:84px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--ink);font:700 42px/1 var(--f-display)}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li[data-correct]{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li[data-correct]::before{background:var(--on-brand);color:var(--brand-text)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="reveal"]:not(.is-on) li[data-correct]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--rule-strong);color:var(--ink)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="reveal"]:not(.is-on) li[data-correct]::before{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--ink)}
[data-layout="quiz"] .lede{margin-block-start:36px;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)))}
/* materials: a board of swatches, textures or photos with captions */
[data-layout="materials"] h2{margin-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="materials"] .board{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:36px;counter-reset:mat}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;min-width:0;counter-increment:mat}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat::before{content:"";flex:1;min-height:160px;background:var(--tx,linear-gradient(transparent,transparent)),var(--sw,var(--bg2));border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 16%,transparent)}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat:has(img)::before{display:none}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat img{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:var(--radius)}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat figcaption b{display:block;font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));font-weight:650;line-height:1.2}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat figcaption span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:max(28px,calc(24px*var(--fit)))/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat figcaption span::before{content:"M-0" counter(mat) "  "}
/* formula: one big equation and its terms */
[data-layout="formula"] h2{margin-block-end:24px}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:400;font-size:calc(140px*var(--fit));line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-0.01em;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;padding:36px 0;margin-block:auto 44px;border-block:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong)}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq i{font-style:italic}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq sub{font-size:max(28px,.5em);line-height:0;font-style:normal}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq .hot{color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms:not(:has(~ .example)){margin-block-end:auto}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px 72px}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:0 20px;align-items:baseline;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.3}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dt{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.15em;color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dt i{font-style:italic}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dt sub{font-size:max(28px,.6em);line-height:0}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="formula"] .example{margin-block-end:auto;margin-block-start:36px;font:calc(32px*var(--fit))/1.4 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
/* chip: a boxed inline token */
.chip{display:inline-block;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:.12em .5em;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.25}
.chip.hot{background:var(--hot);border-color:var(--hot);color:var(--on-brand)}
.chip-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;font-size:56px}

/* footer (not on title / section / full-bleed / closing) */
.kp-foot{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;bottom:36px;inset-inline:120px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 20px/1.2 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
.slide:is([data-layout="title"],[data-layout="section"],[data-layout="full-bleed"],[data-layout="closing"],[data-footer="off"]) .kp-foot{display:none}

/* ---------- 4. Builds ---------- (hidden states exist only on live slides, never in thumbnails or print) */
.kp-live .kb{transition:opacity .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),clip-path .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="fade"],.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="count"]{opacity:0}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="rise"]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(44px)}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="scale"]{opacity:0;transform:scale(.88)}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="wipe"]{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}
[dir="rtl"] .kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="wipe"]{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 100%)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="wipe"].is-on{clip-path:inset(-20px -20px -20px -20px)}
.kd{stroke-dasharray:1 2;stroke-dashoffset:0}
.kp-live .kd{transition:stroke-dashoffset 1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) calc(var(--i,0)*.12s)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="draw"]:not(.is-on) .kd,.kp-live .kd.kb[data-kb="draw"]:not(.is-on){stroke-dashoffset:1}
.kp-instant .kb,.kp-instant .kb *{transition:none!important}
.kp-rm .kb,.kp-rm .kb *{transition:none!important}
/* chart builds: axes stay, data arrives */
.kp-live .chart.kb{transition:none}
.kp-live .chart .bar{transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) calc(var(--i)*.09s)}
.kp-live .chart .val,.kp-live .chart .dot{transition:opacity .5s ease calc(var(--i)*.09s + .4s)}
.kp-live .chart .ln-path{transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.3s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.kp-live .chart.kb:not(.is-on) .bar-c{transform:scaleY(0)}
.kp-live .chart.kb:not(.is-on) .bar-r{transform:scaleX(0)}
.kp-live .chart.kb:not(.is-on) :is(.val,.dot){opacity:0}
.kp-live .chart.kb:not(.is-on) .ln-path{stroke-dashoffset:1}
/* code focus builds */
pre.code .ln{transition:opacity .45s}
.kp-rm pre.code .ln{transition:none}
pre.code[data-f] .ln:not(.hl){opacity:.34}
html.kp-all pre.code .ln,.kp-frame pre.code .ln{opacity:1!important}

/* ---------- 5. Chart, code, tables ---------- */
.chart{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;margin:0}
.chart .plot{flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative}
.chart svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible;font-family:var(--f-body);direction:ltr}
.chart .grid{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:1}
.chart .axis{stroke:var(--rule-strong);stroke-width:2}
.chart text{fill:var(--ink2);font-size:var(--t-small)}
.chart .cat{font-size:var(--t-small);fill:var(--ink)}
.chart .val{font-size:28px;font-weight:650;fill:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.chart .val.multi{font-size:var(--t-small)}
.chart .bar{transform-box:fill-box}.chart .bar-c{transform-origin:50% 100%}.chart .bar-r{transform-origin:0 50%}
[dir="rtl"] .chart .bar-r{transform-origin:100% 50%}
.chart .s1{fill:var(--s1)}.chart .s2{fill:var(--s2)}.chart .s3{fill:var(--s3)}
.chart .muted{fill:var(--muted-bar)}
.chart .bar.ref,.chart .bar.muted{stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:2}
.chart .bar.ref{fill:var(--muted-bar)}
.chart .legend i.ref{background:var(--muted-bar);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink2)}
.chart .ln-path.ref{stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:none}
.chart .tgt{stroke:var(--hot);stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:14 10}
.chart text.tgt-l{fill:var(--hot-text,var(--brand-text));font-size:var(--t-small);font-weight:600}
.chart text.delta{fill:var(--brand-text);font-size:var(--t-small);font-weight:700}
.chart .dot.mute{opacity:.5}
.chart .ln-path{fill:none;stroke-width:6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-dasharray:1 2}
.chart .ln-path.s1{stroke:var(--s1)}.chart .ln-path.s2{stroke:var(--s2)}.chart .ln-path.s3{stroke:var(--s3)}
.chart .dot{fill:var(--bg);stroke-width:5}.chart .dot.s1{stroke:var(--s1)}.chart .dot.s2{stroke:var(--s2)}.chart .dot.s3{stroke:var(--s3)}
.chart .dot.s1,.chart .dot.s2,.chart .dot.s3{fill:var(--bg)}
.chart .legend{display:flex;gap:40px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 20px;font-size:var(--t-small);color:var(--ink2)}
.chart .legend li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.chart .legend i{width:22px;height:22px;display:block}
.chart .legend .s1{background:var(--s1)}.chart .legend .s2{background:var(--s2)}.chart .legend .s3{background:var(--s3)}
.chart figcaption{font:var(--t-small)/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2);margin-top:18px}
pre.code{background:var(--code-bg);color:var(--code-ink);font:400 calc(36px*var(--fit))/1.62 var(--f-mono);padding:44px 56px;border-radius:var(--radius);direction:ltr;text-align:left;white-space:pre;overflow:hidden;tab-size:2;margin-block:auto;max-width:1680px}
.slide pre.code{margin-block:auto}
pre.code .ln{display:block;min-height:1.62em}
pre.code .k{color:var(--c-kw)}pre.code .s{color:var(--c-str)}pre.code .n{color:var(--c-num)}pre.code .c{color:var(--c-com);font-style:italic}pre.code .f{color:var(--c-fn)}
table.cmp{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));table-layout:fixed}
table.cmp th,table.cmp td{padding:calc(34px*var(--fit)) 36px;text-align:start;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);line-height:1.3}
table.cmp thead th{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);letter-spacing:var(--ls-display);font-size:calc(54px*var(--fit));border-bottom:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:64px;vertical-align:bottom;position:relative}
table.cmp thead th:first-child,table.cmp tbody th{font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:500;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));color:var(--ink2);letter-spacing:0}
table.cmp tbody th{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2)}
table.cmp td{color:var(--ink)}
table.cmp .rec{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand) var(--rec-mix),var(--bg))}
table.cmp thead th.rec{border-top:6px solid var(--brand);color:var(--ink)}
table.cmp thead th.rec::before{content:attr(data-tag);position:absolute;top:12px;inset-inline-start:36px;font:500 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text);letter-spacing:.02em}
table.cmp td b{font-weight:650}

/* ---------- 6. Chrome: toolbar, progress, screens, pen (fixed neutral UI, deliberately NOT themed) ---------- */
.kp-ui{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:56px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:4px;padding:6px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(24,24,26,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);z-index:50;transition:opacity .35s;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;color:#fff}
.kp-ui button,.kp-pen button,.kp-set button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer;min-width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:9px;color:#f2f2f2;font:500 15px system-ui,sans-serif}
.kp-ui button:hover,.kp-pen button:hover,.kp-set button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.kp-ui button:focus-visible,.kp-pen button:focus-visible,.kp-set button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #6db3ff;outline-offset:1px}
.kp-ui button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.24)}
.kp-ui button[hidden]{display:none}
.kp-ui svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.kp-ui .kp-count{padding:0 10px;min-width:70px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;opacity:.85;pointer-events:none;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px}
.kp-ui .kp-sep{width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);margin:8px 4px}
html.kp-idle .kp-ui{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}html.kp-idle .kp-ui:focus-within,html.kp-idle .kp-pen:focus-within{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}html.kp-idle,html.kp-idle *{cursor:none!important}
@media (max-width:760px),(max-height:480px){ /* small windows and embeds: a compact bar with the essentials */
  .kp-ui{bottom:8px;padding:3px;gap:2px;border-radius:10px}.kp-ui button{min-width:36px;height:36px}.kp-ui svg{width:18px;height:18px}
  .kp-ui .kp-count{min-width:50px;padding:0 4px;font-size:12px}.kp-ui .kp-sep{margin:6px 2px}
  .kp-ui :is([data-act="outline"],[data-act="pres"],[data-act="link"],[data-act="pen"]){display:none}}
html.kp-clean :is(.kp-ui,.kp-pen,.kp-set,.kp-ol,.kp-progress,.kp-toast,.kp-laser){display:none!important}
.kp-progress{position:fixed;left:0;bottom:0;height:4px;width:100%;background:var(--brand,#0066cc);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .4s;z-index:40;pointer-events:none}
[dir="rtl"] .kp-progress{transform-origin:100% 50%}
.kp-live-region{position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden}
.kp-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:#000;display:none;color:#8e8e93;font:500 22px system-ui,sans-serif;place-items:center}.kp-screen.white{background:#fff}.kp-screen.on{display:block}.kp-screen.on.end{display:grid}
.kp-toast{position:fixed;top:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:rgba(24,24,26,.9);color:#fff;font:600 28px system-ui,sans-serif;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:12px;z-index:95;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none}
.kp-toast.on{opacity:1}
.kp-ink{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;z-index:30;pointer-events:none;touch-action:none}
html.kp-penmode .kp-ink{pointer-events:auto;cursor:crosshair}
.kp-laser{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:34px;height:34px;margin:-17px 0 0 -17px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ff2d20 0 28%,rgba(255,45,32,.55) 45%,rgba(255,45,32,0) 70%);pointer-events:none;z-index:96;display:none}
html.kp-laser-on .kp-laser{display:block}html.kp-laser-on,html.kp-laser-on *{cursor:none!important}
.kp-pen{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:124px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:none;gap:4px;padding:6px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(24,24,26,.9);z-index:51;align-items:center}
html.kp-penmode .kp-pen{display:flex}
.kp-pen .sw{width:44px;height:44px}.kp-pen .sw::after{content:"";width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.kp-pen .sw[aria-pressed="true"]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.kp-pen button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
html.kp-idle.kp-penmode .kp-pen{opacity:0}
.kp-set{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:124px;width:360px;max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;padding:18px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(24,24,26,.94);color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;z-index:60;display:none}
.kp-set.on{display:block}
.kp-set h4{margin:0 0 10px;font:600 13px system-ui;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#a8a8ad}.kp-set h4+div{margin-bottom:18px}
.kp-set h5{grid-column:1/-1;margin:10px 0 2px;font:600 12px system-ui;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#8e8e93;text-transform:uppercase}.kp-set h5:first-child{margin-top:0}
.kp-set .opts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.kp-set .opts button{justify-content:start;padding:0 12px;height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-size:15px;text-align:start}
.kp-set .opts button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#fff;color:#111;border-color:#fff}

Data, Samples & Describing Data

By the end of the hour you can tell a sample from a population, choose a graph for any variable, and read the centre, spread and shape of a set of numbers.

STATS 101Introductory · no prior statisticsPrerequisite: high-school algebra

Open on the promise, not a joke: by the end of these 50 minutes every student can (1) tell a population from a sample and a parameter from a statistic, (2) classify a variable and its level of measurement, (3) spot how data are collected and where bias hides, (4) choose the right graph, and (5) compute and interpret the mean, median, mode, range, IQR, standard deviation, z-scores and the 68-95-99.7 rule. This is the first time most of them have met statistics — keep the energy up. The three questions on the next slide structure the whole hour.

The three questions

How the hour is built

  1. Where do the data come from? ~15 min
  2. What kind of data are they? ~10 min
  3. What do the data say? ~25 min

Signpost the room. Everything today answers one of these three questions. "Where do the data come from?" covers the two opening stories, population vs sample, how data are collected, sampling methods and bias. "What kind of data?" covers the types and levels of variables. "What do the data say?" is the biggest part — graphs, shape, centre, spread, outliers, z-scores, the 68-95-99.7 rule and correlation. We'll return to this list at each section break.

Why statistics?

Statistics is the science of collecting, describing and drawing conclusions from data — in the presence of variation and uncertainty.

This is the whole subject in one sentence, and we'll say it three ways today: now, at the section breaks, and again at the close. Hammer "variation and uncertainty" — that is exactly why statistics exists and why we need a sample and a measure of uncertainty. The two branches on the next slide are descriptive and inferential; most of this module is descriptive.

Two branches, found everywhere

Descriptive

Summarise the data we already have: tables, graphs, averages. Most of this module.

Inferential

Use a sample to draw conclusions about a larger population, with a measure of uncertainty. Later modules.

In everyday life

  • Opinion polls
  • Clinical trials
  • Sports analytics
  • Weather forecasts
  • Website A/B tests

Make the two branches concrete. Descriptive is what this module is — you summarise what you have. Inferential (later modules) uses a sample to say something about a population you can't measure fully, and always attaches a measure of uncertainty. The right-hand column shows they're everywhere: polls, medicine, sport, weather, the A/B tests behind the buttons you click. Point out that "descriptive" is the safe ground; inference is where things get subtle.

Question one

1

Where do the data come from?

Two stories, then population, sample, and how data are collected.

Story one · London, 1854

John Snow maps cholera

During a cholera outbreak in Soho, Snow marked each death on a street map. The deaths clustered around one water pump on Broad Street. The pump's handle was removed.

Image placeholder: John Snow's 1854 cholera map of Soho — deaths marked as X's, clustered around the Broad Street pump.

Tell the story, not the dates. In 1854, during a cholera outbreak in Soho, John Snow did something radical: he drew the data. He marked each death on a street map, and the marks clustered around a single water pump on Broad Street. When the pump's handle was removed, the outbreak eased. The point is not the medicine — it's that a simple picture of data pointed straight to the cause. (Swap the empty frame for Snow's actual map image; caption is in the slide.)

Story two · US election, 1936

The Literary Digest poll

The huge poll

  • About 10 million ballots mailed
  • About 2.4 million returned
  • Drawn from phone books & car lists
  • Predicted: Alf Landon wins

The small poll

  • George Gallup, about 50,000 people
  • A better-chosen sample
  • Predicted: F. D. Roosevelt wins
  • Roosevelt won ~61% of the vote, 46 of 48 states

The contrast that defines the whole hour. The Literary Digest mailed ~10 million ballots and got ~2.4 million back — an enormous sample — yet drew its lists from telephone directories and car registrations, which in 1936 left out poorer voters, and it predicted Alf Landon. George Gallup used a far smaller sample of about 50,000, better chosen, and correctly predicted Roosevelt, who won about 61% of the popular vote and 46 of the 48 states. The big poll lost; the small one won. Hold the numbers: 10 million vs 50,000.

A huge biased sample is worse than a small, well-chosen one.

How data are collected matters more than how much there is.

State the takeaway plainly — this is the second way we say the story. Size is not quality. The Digest's 2.4 million were drawn from sources that systematically left out part of the electorate, so more data made the error look more confident, not less. Gallup's 50,000 were better chosen and beat it. Repeat it: more data does not fix a bad sample. Everything in this section (population, sampling, bias) exists to keep us from that trap.

Population, sample, parameter, statistic

From the whole group to one number

Four ideas on one picture. Population = the whole group (all students at the university); sample = the part we actually measure (say, 200 who answered a survey). The hot dots are the few chosen for the sample. A parameter (population mean μ, population standard deviation σ) describes the population and is usually unknown; a statistic (sample mean x̄, sample standard deviation s) is computed from the sample and is our estimate of the parameter. The memory aid: P→P, S→S. Three clicks: boxes, arrows, then the numbers.

Parameter vs statistic

Parameter

A number describing the population — usually unknown. Notation: the mean μ and standard deviation σ.

Statistic

A number computed from the sample, used to estimate the parameter. Notation: the mean x̄ and standard deviation s.

Keep the notation tight. Population quantities use Greek letters: μ for the population mean, σ for the population standard deviation. Sample quantities are the Latin versions: x̄ (x-bar) for the sample mean, s for the sample standard deviation. The statistic is the estimate; the parameter is the truth we're trying to reach. Reinforce the memory aid P→P, S→S — it survives the rest of the course.

Two families of variables

Categorical

  • Nominal — no order: blood type, favourite colour, country
  • Ordinal — a natural order: satisfaction (low / med / high), year of study

Numerical

  • Discrete — counts, whole numbers: siblings, goals scored
  • Continuous — measured on a scale: height, time, temperature

Watch out

Numbers aren't always numerical data. A postcode or a student ID is categorical — averaging them means nothing.

Every variable is either categorical or numerical. Categorical: nominal has no order (blood type, favourite colour, country); ordinal has a natural order (satisfaction low/medium/high, year of study). Numerical: discrete are counts of whole numbers (number of siblings, goals scored); continuous are measured on a scale (height, time, temperature). The "watch out" is the trap students fall into: a postcode or a student ID looks numerical but is categorical — you can't average them, it's meaningless. Ask the room which family each of a few examples belongs to.

Question two · what kind of data

Levels of measurement

Order?Equal intervals?True zero?Example
NominalNoNoNoeye colour
OrdinalYesNoNorace finishing position
IntervalYesYesNotemperature in °C
RatioYesYesYesweight, income, time

The levels sharpen the two families. Nominal: no order, no equal intervals, no true zero (eye colour). Ordinal: order but no equal spacing and no true zero (race finishing position). Interval: order and equal intervals but no true zero (temperature in degrees Celsius). Ratio: all three (weight, income, time). Why it matters: 20°C is not "twice as hot" as 10°C because Celsius has no true zero (it's interval), but 20 kg is twice 10 kg because weight has a true zero (it's ratio). Don't let students take ratios for an interval scale.

Collecting the data

2

How is the data collected?

Observation or experiment, sampling methods, and the biases that mislead.

Observation vs experiment

Observational study

Observe and measure without assigning treatments — e.g. surveying students about sleep and grades. It can show an association, but not cause and effect.

Experiment

  • A control group for comparison
  • Random assignment — groups alike apart from the treatment
  • A placebo where possible, and blinding (double-blind)
  • Only a randomised experiment shows cause and effect

The distinction that protects us from false claims. An observational study (surveying students about sleep and grades) only reveals an association — it can't prove cause. An experiment assigns treatments and compares outcomes, and a good one uses four tools: a control group for comparison, random assignment so the groups are alike except for the treatment, a placebo where possible, and blinding (double-blind: neither subjects nor researchers know who got what). Only a well-designed randomised experiment can establish cause and effect — say that as a rule students can quote.

Five ways to sample

MethodHow it worksExample
Simple randomEvery group of n has the same chancedraw 100 student IDs at random
StratifiedSplit into groups (strata), sample each25 students from each year of study
ClusterSplit into groups, choose whole groupspick 5 lecture sections, survey all in them
SystematicEvery k-th from a list, after a random startevery 20th name on the class list
ConvenienceWhoever is easiest to reach — not random, avoidasking friends in the cafeteria

Five sampling methods. Simple random: every group of n has the same chance of being chosen (draw 100 student IDs at random). Stratified: split into groups — strata — and take a random sample from each (25 students from each year of study). Cluster: split into groups and randomly choose whole groups (pick 5 lecture sections and survey everyone in them). Systematic: every k-th individual from a list after a random start (every 20th name on the class list). Convenience: whoever is easiest to reach — this is NOT random; avoid it (asking friends in the cafeteria). The first four are legitimate; convenience is the one to flag.

Bias: when a sample misleads

  • Selection bias — the way you choose the sample leaves out part of the population (the Digest's phone and car lists).
  • Non-response bias — the people who don't respond differ from those who do.
  • Response bias — the wording or setting pushes an answer ("Don't you agree that…?").
  • Voluntary response bias — only people with strong opinions take part (online polls, call-in shows).
  • A bigger sample does not fix bias — it only makes a biased answer look more precise.

Four biases, then the punchline. Selection bias: how the sample is chosen leaves out part of the population — the Digest's phone and car lists left out poorer voters. Non-response bias: those who don't respond differ from those who do. Response bias: the wording or setting pushes people toward an answer ("Don't you agree that…?"). Voluntary response bias: only people with strong opinions choose to take part — online polls, call-in shows. The punchline, repeated from the Digest: a bigger sample does not fix bias; it only makes a biased answer look more precise. Bias is about direction, not size.

Question three

3

What do the data say?

Graphs, shape, centre, spread, outliers, z-scores and correlation.

Choosing the right graph

DataGraphWhat it shows
One categoricalBar chart (or pie)counts or percentages per category
One numericalHistogramshape of the distribution
One numericalBox plotfive-number summary & outliers
Two numericalScatter plotrelationship: direction, form, strength
A variable over timeLine graphtrends

Match the graph to the data. One categorical variable: a bar chart (or a pie chart) shows counts or percentages per category. One numerical variable: a histogram shows the shape of the distribution; a box plot shows the five-number summary and outliers. Two numerical variables: a scatter plot shows the relationship — its direction, form and strength. A variable over time: a line graph shows trends. The golden rule of the next slide: always plot the data before you compute anything.

Always plot the data first

Four pictures, the same numbers

This is the reason to plot first. Anscombe's quartet, 1973: four small data sets, 11 points each, with almost the same mean of x (9), mean of y (about 7.50), correlation (about 0.816) and regression line (y = 3 + 0.5x). Yet the four scatter plots are completely different: a straight-line cloud, a curve, a line with a single outlier, and a vertical stack with one far point. Summary numbers can hide the story. Draw the two trend lines on click 2. Tell students: never trust the mean and correlation alone — always look at the plot.

Describe a distribution in four moves

The four moves

  • Shape — symmetric or skewed; one or two peaks
  • Centre — where the typical value sits
  • Spread — how much values vary
  • Unusual — outliers and gaps

Centre, three ways

  • Mean — add the values, divide by n: x̄ = Σx / n
  • Median — the middle of the ordered data
  • Mode — the most frequent value

Every description of a numerical variable covers four moves: shape (symmetric, skewed right with a long right tail like incomes, or skewed left; one peak is unimodal, two is bimodal), centre (where the typical value is), spread (how much values vary), and unusual features (outliers and gaps). We start with centre, three ways: the mean, x̄ = Σx / n; the median, the middle value of the ordered data (average the two middle values if n is even); and the mode, the most frequent value. The next slides work a single example through all of this.

We start with centre, three ways: the mean, x̄ = Σx / n; the median, the middle value of the ordered data (average the two middle values if n is even); and the mode, the most frequent value. The next slides work a single example through all of this.
